ideas.pitch: An autonomous cloud infrastructure tuning agent that combines LLM reasoning with Kubernetes operator loops to optimize cloud costs and carbon footprints.
ideas.title: CloudGen-Ops Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hackathon theme of Generative AI × Cloud by proving measurable real-world impact through cloud cost savings and resource optimization.

ideas.pitch: A secure, zero-leakage RAG retrieval toolkit deployed serverlessly on cloud infrastructure for enterprise document querying with strict audit logging.
ideas.title: RAG-Vault Cloud
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on responsible data usage and scalable cloud deployment, key judging criteria explicitly called out in the event guidelines.

ideas.pitch: An ethical AI governance and telemetry platform that monitors cloud-hosted LLM outputs for safety, compliance, and hallucination drift in real-time.
ideas.title: CloudGuard Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges value responsible AI implementation and governance platforms that address production-readiness in enterprise environments.

ideas.title: Serverless-Dev Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a pain familiar to developers and judges alike by streamlining cloud configuration through generative AI workflows.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous IT service management agent running on cloud infrastructure that handles automated incident triage, ticketing, and remediation workflows.
ideas.title: Cloud-Native ITSM Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical applications of AI with efficient cloud deployment and measurable business impact, matching the main theme criteria.
